## Standing operator rules
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.  
Always bind Ledgerly’s trace context by calling `bind_request_id()` from `ledgerly/observability/context.py` at the start of every HTTP handler.  
Before changing retention behavior in `ledgerly/services/retention.py`, attach the expected deletion count to the `ledgerly-privacy-impact` ticket and request sign-off from the designated privacy approver. Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` in order, one step at a time.

## Current objective
Continue invoice-test fixture/performance refactoring. The Tenacity refactor is superseded and paused until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen and must never be seeded or written to. Migration: `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`; index: `search_vectors_tenant_document_idx` on `(tenant_id, document_id)`. CSV uses UTF-8. Host/deployment: `production/orders-api`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Tenant-less scans: 184,221 rows/8.42s. Platform-default CSV encoding broke UTF-8. httpx 0.23 broke Stripe. Generator return failed invoice typing.

## Plan and progress
Credential rotation steps 1–5 done; step 5 was `kubectl rollout restart deployment/orders-api -n production` (exit 0). Step 6 command is not recorded. Invoice helper, `organization_factory`, and module-scoped ten-customer batch added.

## Recent work
Targeted tests passed: invoices 46/46; customers 31 passed, 2 skipped. Payment-history loading remains the performance hotspot.
